body: Root-caused the founder-reported 'no players/enemies visible' and 'Q/W/E dont seem to work' bugs. apps/arena_bot's wait_for_match() resends PACKET_FIND_MATCH after ~5s of silence; if that resend was still in flight the instant the matchmaker matched and dequeued the client, the late retry got silently re-enqueued, permanently costing some future lobby one slot (that address's owner is already off connecting elsewhere and never sees the resulting second PACKET_MATCH_FOUND). With 19 bots continuously cycling through matches this became the reason almost every lobby landed at 19/20 and timed out -- and fully explains the cast-bug report too: a match stuck in ARENA_PHASE_WAITING never reaches ARENA_PHASE_LIVE, so casts are correctly rejected the whole time, not broken. Fixed with a 10s post-match cooldown per address in the matchmaker, ignoring late duplicate FIND_MATCH requests instead of re-queuing them. Verified live: before the fix, every attempt against the real pool capped at 19/20; after rebuild+restart, the first attempt reached a genuine 20/20 lobby, all heroes picked, match live, real snapshots streaming. Commit 1e1e14f.
title: Fix matchmaker phantom-requeue race — closes S170-85 and S170-86
